module.name: Slot Unlock
config.enabled.desc: Lets you put any item into slots that normally only accept certain items. Servers need the mod installed and must grant you permission
config.shulker_box.desc: Allow shulker boxes inside shulker boxes
config.armor.desc: Allow any item in armor slots, and allow taking off items with Curse of Binding
config.furnace.desc: Allow any item in furnace fuel and result slots
config.brewing_stand.desc: Allow any item in brewing stand slots
config.mount.desc: Allow any item in horse, llama and other mount equipment slots
config.bundle.desc: Allow shulker boxes and bundles inside bundles
config.permission_level.desc: Players need at least this operator level for the server to accept unlocked slots
